QUOTE: **Default (`MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` not defined):** `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to `private_x`. ... **Opt-out (`MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` defined):** `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to `x`, and the field has its real name.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both the default expansion to private_<member> and the unchanged-name expansion when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
